welcome: Hello! Each question is sent independently; I do not keep chat history. You can ask once every {seconds} seconds.
help:
Commands:
/start - Welcome
/help - Show instructions
/ping - Check availability
/ask [provider] <question> - Ask a question
/providers - List providers and models
/version - Show the version

Example: /ask What is AI?
empty_prompt: Please provide a question after /ask or the provider name.
provider_error: The request could not be completed. Please try again later or contact the bot operator.
